query:
UPDATE jobs
        SET status = 'cancelled'::job_status,
            finished_at = NOW()
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND status IN ('queued'::job_status, 'running'::job_status)
          AND job_type IN ('ingest_metadata'::job_type, 'ingest_thumbnails'::job_type, 'ingest_analysis'::job_type)
